decisions.reason: Clearly distinguishes clipboardText/InputState.draft offsets (chip expands to clipboard form) from detect-coordinate TokenSpan for insertReference/consumeToken (chip = one U+FFFC), grounded in contract/facade line citations with the drift formula.

Identifies snapshot.draft.length (29) vs 2-unit detect text, empty-composer coincidence for paste #1, splice failure returning false and the mislabelled changed-composer toast; explicitly shows rev/phase guards pass so no real concurrent edit is inferred.

Traces remove step by line: [0,28) clipboard span fed to detect-space consumeToken, boolean discarded, records.delete runs anyway; occurrence survives, dock renders unavailable from missing record; ties both to the same misread, not a separate failure.

Provides concrete toDetect subtracting Σ(length-1) for preceding chips, applies it at both call sites (insert at detect end per loop iteration; removal maps offset and uses start+1 one-char span), keeps draftRev unconverted, and deletes records only on success or host-verified removal.

T2/T3 cover two successive pastes with both chips present; T7 removes a chip with a preceding chip asserting span [2,3), grouped removal of occurrence/dock chip/record and the other chip intact; adds declined-consumption (T9), first/last-chip and empty-again (T6/T10) variants.
